<?php
function right_ctrl7($formal = 13) {
    declare(ticks=0);
    echo "RIGHT|";
    return func_num_args();
}
function outer_ctrl7($formal = 13) {
    declare(ticks=0);
    $formal = 99;
    echo "AND|";
    $and = func_num_args() && right_ctrl7();
    echo (int)$and, "|OR|";
    $or = \func_num_args() || right_ctrl7();
    echo (int)$or, "|";
    return $formal;
}
$value = outer_ctrl7();
echo "RESULT|", $value, "|";

<?php

$value = outer_ctrl7(3, 7);
echo "RESULT|", $value, "|";
